title: [MTR4] British Rail Class 345 Sound Enhancement
description: Replaces the default MTR Class 345 sound (used Class 377 sound instead) with the old DB Class 423 sound (from DB Class 442)!
body:
# British Rail Class 345 Sound Enhancement

![Banner image for British Rail Class 345 Sound Enhancement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68ed17a0f7753e9343d9efdbe8d96ace0ac913f2.png)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/wjmm9WLXUTg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This pack adds a new variant of the Class 345 that uses the old DB Class 423 sounds from Minecraft Transit Railway instead of the British Rail Class 377 sounds!
